title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to Blazor WASM
test_name: VS Code extension E2E (matrix shards, e.g. browser-debugger / workspace-target-proof / edge-cases)
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision ...: Error: Timed out after ~299700ms waiting for Blazor WASM root session for resource '<resource>'. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: Both failing tests ('hits a managed breakpoint for hosted-global' and 'hosted-per-page') time out after ~300 seconds waiting for the Blazor WASM debug session to attach. This is a known intermittent timing issue in the browser-debugger E2E shard and is unrelated to the PR, which only modifies generated Foundry model data files (FoundryModel.Generated.cs, FoundryModel.Local.Generated.cs) with no relation to the VS Code extension debugger.
